data.one_liner: Extension methods adding utility functions for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of extension methods for common Dart/Flutter types such as Iterable, String, Duration, Color, and Rect. Adds helpers like tweening, parsing, and collection shortcuts. All extensions are null‑safe and work on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need quick, ready‑made helpers for collections, strings, colors, or durations without writing boilerplate.
You prefer a single dependency that works across Android, iOS, web, desktop, and is MIT licensed.
avoid_when: You require actively maintained code or new features.
You want compile‑time const constructors for colors or durations.
The needed functionality is already covered by Dart's core libraries or the collection package.
strengths: Well‑tested and null‑safe across all Flutter platforms.
Large set of handy extensions covering many common tasks.
MIT license allows easy forking or selective use.
weaknesses: Development discontinued; no new features or bug fixes planned.
Some extensions duplicate functionality now in Dart's core or collection package.
Certain helpers (e.g., Duration, Color) cannot be used with const constructors.
